__provenance__.statement: THIS FILE IS SYNTHESISED FROM A DOCUMENT AND IS NOT A CAPTURE. It was written by reading docs/opnsense-api-survey.md, never by recording a response from an OPNsense firewall. If the survey is wrong about a field, an envelope or a status code, the tests that read this file pass and the collection is still wrong. Do not treat this file as evidence.
__provenance__.survey_section: Telemetry field names, read from source for step 5
__provenance__.field_list_from: interfaces.<interface name> holding the labels ifinfo prints, each value a string: bytes received, bytes transmitted, packets received, packets transmitted, input errors, output errors, collisions, plus name; and a top-level time, as opnsense/core 26.7.3 traffic_stats.php and legacy_interface_stats build them
__provenance__.why_these_values: Keyed by interface identifier under the interfaces wrapper, two interfaces, every counter a string as the controller returns it. The first carries both error counters; the second carries none, so the errors are absent for it rather than zero.
__provenance__.example_values_are_not_a_network: Every identifier, device name and address below is synthesised for this fixture. None of them describes anyone's network, and no code under test presupposes any of them: each is read back out of this file.
